Inside Macintosh: AppleScript Finder Guide /
Chapter 2 - Finder Objects / Using Object Class Definitions

Commands Handled

Objects that belong to the same class can respond to the same commands. Object class definitions list the commands to which all objects of that
class respond.

For example, the definition for File that begins on page 60 indicates that you can use any of these commands to perform actions on a file: Clean Up, Copy, Count, Data Size, Delete, Duplicate, Exists, Get, Make, Move, Open, Print,
Put Away, Reveal, Select, Sort, Update.
